title: The time grain of experience comes from the thalamic loop

statements.text: Conscious experience cannot resolve events faster than the processing time of the thalamocortical loop. Its temporal resolution comes from the propagation time between layer 5 pyramidal neurons, the nonspecific thalamus and higher cortical areas.

sources.quote: we claim that the temporal resolution of conscious experience stems from the propagation time between the L5p neurons, NSP thalamus and higher cortical areas
